axes.label: SKU / stop-sell truth
axes.releaseRequirement: Current SKU catalogue, public surfaces and entitlement minting agree; disabled or invitation-only products cannot be sold by URL, receipt, browser state or provider callback.

axes.label: Server entitlement / revocation
axes.releaseRequirement: Paid access is server-authoritative, tenant-bound, revocable and replay-safe on the final deployed runtime.

axes.label: Checkout / public contract / auth
axes.releaseRequirement: Checkout, verification and success flows use pinned customer-safe schemas and authenticated server-side policy.

axes.label: Stripe webhook / replay / idempotency
axes.releaseRequirement: Stripe TEST lifecycle passes on current build/staging with signature verification, replay denial, idempotency and reconciliation.

axes.label: Refund / cancel / revoke lifecycle
axes.releaseRequirement: Refund, cancellation, chargeback/dispute and entitlement revocation are tested end-to-end with customer-safe state transitions.

axes.label: Customer delivery / support projection
axes.releaseRequirement: Paid artifacts, receipts, account messages and support handoff are tenant-bound, customer-safe and operationally deliverable.

axes.label: Tenant / privacy / retention
axes.releaseRequirement: Disposable staging proves tenant isolation and privacy lifecycle; retention, deletion, export and processor boundaries are approved.

axes.label: Provider / data rights
axes.releaseRequirement: Every paid-output field has a current commercial-use/display/retention/redistribution/AI/PDF rights decision.

axes.label: Merchant / legal identity / customer terms
axes.releaseRequirement: Merchant identity, tax, support, terms, privacy, refunds, dispute handling and required legal classifications are approved.

axes.label: Final tier-value holdout
axes.releaseRequirement: Frozen same-input Basic/Pro/Advanced holdouts prove material paid delta, acceptable factuality/FN/FP and bounded refund risk.

axes.label: Clean build / staging / operations
axes.releaseRequirement: Clean lockfile install, project typecheck, production build, staging identity, observability, restore and rollback pass on final bytes.

axes.label: Real customer value / WTP / refund evidence
axes.releaseRequirement: Pre-registered real-customer protocol provides utility, comprehension, WTP, negative evidence and refund-expectation results.

nonAliasing: GO_INTERNAL progress does not automatically advance GO_PAID.
Local Stripe fixture evidence is not Stripe production or staging credit.
Internal AI review is not professional legal or independent external credit.
Code presence and API credentials do not grant provider commercial rights.
Fixture tier output is not final holdout customer value.
A planning estimate is not a release decision.
